functions.plate_comment: Command encoding only: int value==0 becomes 60, otherwise preserve all 32 bits; sent_cmd_sigle_thread(0xd3,4,&value,1), up to three attempts with 20ms sleeps after failures. Returns 0 on nonnegative sender result, negative init/send error otherwise. If UART was not already initialized, initializes and closes it locally. Target is little-endian ARM32, so four-byte -1 is ff ff ff ff. No periodic heartbeat production is established here; MCU meaning of 60/120/-1, sender completion semantics, reset safety and active producer remain unresolved.

Surviving symbol preserved. Tail-calls rua_keep_mcu_heartbeat(-1), transmitting command 0xd3 with four bytes ff ff ff ff if send succeeds. Name does not prove MCU/kernel behavior or safe indefinite map-writer stop. Returns callee result.
